target.title: Keep Claude login on Auto source after setup
target.body:
Fixes #1970.

## Summary

- Keep Claude's usage source on `auto` after a successful Claude login flow instead of pinning it to `oauth`.
- Add a focused regression test for the post-login source policy.

## Current-main verification

- Refreshed `steipete/CodexBar` `main` on 2026-07-07 before opening this PR.
- `Sources/CodexBar/Providers/Claude/ClaudeLoginFlow.swift` still forces `.oauth` after successful login.
- The settings UI still documents Auto as fallback-capable: "Auto falls back to the next source if the preferred one fails."
- `SettingsStoreTests` still expects the default Claude source to be `.auto`.
- A dry merge into refreshed `upstream/main` has no conflict.

## Why

CodexBar defaults Claude to Auto, and Auto is the fallback-capable source mode. The login flow currently persists `oauth` after the runner reports success. If OAuth credentials are not readable afterward, that removes the fallback path and can leave the app repeatedly asking for Claude credentials.

Keeping the post-login source on Auto preserves the intended resilient behavior: OAuth can still be used when available, but CLI/Web fallback remains available when OAuth is not usable.

## Commands run

- `swift test --filter ClaudeLoginFlowPolicyTests`
- `make check`
- `make test` - did not complete because existing `AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests.swift:117` fails outside this change: expected completed refresh count `1`, got `2`.
- `swift test --no-parallel --filter AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests` - reproduces the same unrelated `AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests.swift:117` failure.

## Screenshots

Not applicable; this is a provider settings/source policy change with no UI changes.
